items.text: Wherever you are with God, there is a next step for you. Start with one.
Join us for one of our services, Sundays at 10:00am or Wednesdays at 7:00pm.
Learn what it means to know Him personally.
Discover your purpose, your gifts and your place in the church.
Make a public declaration of your faith in water baptism.
Do life together and grow with others in a small group.
Use your gifts to serve and make a difference.
